The log itself

Source: R/log-inspect.R
lake_log.Rd

Functions that return what _delta_log/ holds, as data frames:

Usage

lake_log(tbl)

lake_actions(tbl, version, int64 = c("double", "integer64"))

lake_changes(
  tbl,
  from,
  to = lake_version(tbl),
  int64 = c("double", "integer64")
)

lake_transactions(tbl, int64 = c("double", "integer64"))

lake_domains(tbl)

lake_checkpoints(tbl)

Arguments

tbl

A snapshot, from lake_open() or lake_load().

version

The version of the commit to return, a whole number. Its commit file must still be in the log.

int64

How 64-bit integers from the log are returned: "double" (the default), exact up to 2^53 - 1 and an error of class zulake_error_int64 beyond it, or "integer64", from the bit64 package, exact from -2^63 + 1 to 2^63 - 1 (bit64 keeps -2^63 for NA, so that value is an error too). It applies to the columns that hold 64-bit counts and values; inside an action or commitInfo as the log writes it, only a number a double cannot hold becomes an integer64.

from, to

The two versions to compare, whole numbers with from at most to. to defaults to the snapshot's version.

Value

lake_log(): a data frame name, kind ("commit", "checkpoint", "compaction", "checksum" or "last_checkpoint"), version (the first version of a compaction file, NA for _last_checkpoint), end_version (compaction files only), part and parts (multi-part checkpoints only), size and modification_time, sorted by name.

lake_actions(): a data frame with one row per action: version, line (the action's line in the commit file), type ("add", "remove", "metaData", "protocol", "commitInfo", "txn", or any other name the log uses) and action, a list column holding the action as the log writes it.

lake_changes(): a data frame with the columns of lake_files(stats = FALSE) after a first column change, "added" for a file live at to and not at from, "removed" for the reverse. A file is identified by its path and deletion vector, as the protocol does, so a file given a new deletion vector is removed and added.

lake_transactions(): a data frame app_id, version and last_updated (POSIXct, NA when the action has none), sorted by application.

lake_domains(): a data frame domain and configuration (the domain's configuration string, as the log writes it), sorted by domain.

lake_checkpoints(): a data frame version, name, type ("classic", "multi-part" or "v2"), part, parts, size, modification_time and last_checkpoint (whether _last_checkpoint names this checkpoint's version), sorted by version and name.

Details

  • lake_log(): every entry of the _delta_log/ listing taken when the snapshot was opened, including versions after the snapshot's.

  • lake_actions(): every action of one commit, in file order.

  • lake_changes(): the files added and removed between two versions.

  • lake_transactions(): the latest txn action of each application.

  • lake_domains(): the metadata domains in force (domainMetadata).

  • lake_checkpoints(): the checkpoint files in the listing, and which one _last_checkpoint names.

See also

lake_versions() for the table's versions and history.

Examples

# The example table the package ships: orders partitioned by region, five versions.
path <- system.file("extdata", "orders", package = "zulake")
tbl <- lake_open(path)
lake_log(tbl)[c("name", "kind", "version", "size")]
#>                        name   kind version size
#> 1 00000000000000000000.json commit       0 2850
#> 2 00000000000000000001.json commit       1 2029
#> 3 00000000000000000002.json commit       2 2030
#> 4 00000000000000000003.json commit       3 1152
#> 5 00000000000000000004.json commit       4 2132
lake_actions(tbl, version = 3)[c("line", "type")]
#>   line       type
#> 1    1 commitInfo
#> 2    2        add
#> 3    3     remove
# Version 3 deleted order 5: one file removed, its other rows written again.
lake_changes(tbl, from = 2, to = 3)[c("change", "path")]
#>    change                        path
#> 1   added region=US/part-0010.parquet
#> 2 removed region=US/part-0003.parquet
lake_transactions(tbl)
#>          app_id version        last_updated
#> 1 orders-loader       4 2025-01-10 09:00:00
lake_domains(tbl)
#> [1] domain        configuration
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
lake_checkpoints(tbl)
#> [1] version           name              type              part             
#> [5] parts             size              modification_time last_checkpoint  
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
